name: AZ MediQuip - Peoria
old_description: AZ MediQuip's team understands your situation and provides solutions tailored to your needs.
about:
AZ MediQuip, headquartered in Peoria, Arizona, has been serving the state's home medical equipment needs since 2011. The company operates eight retail showrooms across Arizona, including locations in Phoenix, Scottsdale, Chandler, Mesa, Peoria, Goodyear, Prescott Valley, and Oro Valley.

The company operates as a retailer and rental provider of home medical equipment and supplies. Its showrooms carry a range of products including mobility aids, respiratory equipment, hospital beds, and rehabilitation devices from brands such as ComfyGo, Drive, Inogen, ResMed, and Golden Technologies. AZ MediQuip offers sales, weekly and monthly rentals, in-home installation, equipment repair, and delivery services. The rental fleet mirrors the retail inventory, allowing customers to trial equipment before purchase.

AZ MediQuip serves individuals, families, and healthcare professionals throughout Arizona. Its customer base includes seniors seeking to maintain independence, patients recovering from surgery or injury, and clinical partners requiring equipment for home care. The company also partners with Measurabilies Home Safety LLC to provide free home safety assessments with clinically guided recommendations.

The company emphasizes its large showroom footprint, try-before-you-buy policy, and trained staff who provide personalized guidance. According to AZ MediQuip, its attention to detail and helpful demeanor differentiate it from competitors, aiming to minimize the stress of medical equipment decisions.
